title: The watch
goals: Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# Wait only if Dask looks this way.
# Then cross down.
hints: Look at the start card. The level is played two ways. One program must get through both.
Ask which way Dask looks before you move. `dask.facing == "left"` is `True` when he looks this way.
Wait one tick under the `if`. Move it in by four spaces.
intro: Dask walks his round here. He sometimes looks this way. We must cross when he looks away.
outro: Well done, {wizard}. A good condition keeps us safe.
learned: Now you know how to make a choice, which programmers call a condition, with `if`.
